Fix active fleet showing completed agents as still active
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK6201CTYB6AXEPY2MBSY2B0
Type:      task
Status:    pending
Priority:  1
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  The dispatch engine shows completed invocations as still active. Root cause: in _spawnInvocation (dispatch.ts), the cleanup chain is shadowMutex.runExclusive(runInvocation).then(drainQueues).finally(cleanupActiveDetails). The .then() calls _drainQueues which spawns the NEXT invocation via shadowMutex.runExclusive — but .finally() only runs after .then() completes. This means the old invocation's activeInvocationDetails entry persists until the next invocation finishes. Evidence: agents page shows reviewer as '1 active' with 15m elapsed, but sessions page shows that reviewer session completed 12m ago — the cleanup is blocked behind the currently running worker invocation (which holds the shadowMutex). Fix: move activeInvocationDetails.delete and activeCount decrement into the .runExclusive callback (after emitting the event), BEFORE the drain step. The .then should only handle draining, and .finally should only handle abort controller cleanup.
Tags:      bug, web-ui, daemon, dispatch
Created:   2026-03-08T06:26:16.602Z
